description: The first seed ontology for the Relocation consultation system. This model provides a conservative, reviewable symbolic grammar covering Planet in House, Chiron in House, Major Aspect Grammar, Planet-Angle Contacts, Hybrid Dignity Summaries, Default Orb Doctrine, and Late-House Guidance. It is intentionally incomplete and is designed for professional review, revision, and extension through the Layer 2 Wizard platform.
constitutional_alignment: FOUNDATIONAL_CONSTITUTION.md §0 (Constitutional Chain), §7.6–7.9 (AI Constitutional Limits). This ontology provides symbolic grammar only — not consultation, prediction, or psychological profiles.
authoring_principle: Beta Reference Ontology v1 — conservative, modular, every entry independently reviewable and replaceable.
